text:
Type: striped woven throw cushion
Use: accent seating comfort, on a sofa or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, coastal, contemporary
Materials: woven cotton, textured stitched bands
Colors: warm brick red, ivory white
Shape: square, horizontal stripes of varied widths with wide central bands, fine stitched texture, knife edges, compact
Feel: casual, warm, relaxed
Goes with: white or cream sofas, light wood, terracotta and rust accents; farmhouse or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Striped Decorative Throw Pillow, 17" x 17", Brick Red
product.description: Recycled cotton makes this pillow cozy and casual. Woven yarn-dyed stripes offer a classic feel that blends with any style room. For a different look, flip it over to the solid flax-colored side with ribbed texture. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 17"L x 17"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Removable plush fiber-filled insert included Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
